name: The Root
subtitle: Grounding Bracelet · Smoky Quartz
promise: Smoky quartz on its own: grounding without going all black.
body: Eight-millimetre smoky quartz, translucent warm brown, strung without any metal. Traditionally worn to release a heavy day and feel steady again. Real stock from the studio, and once these are gone we will not restring them.
affirmation: I am here, and that is enough.
seoDescription: Smoky quartz bracelet, traditionally worn for grounding and release. Last pieces, hand-strung in Dubai, next-day delivery across the UAE.
